# Prose

Layout wrapper for rendered Markdown.

`KenosUI.Prose` · Content

## Use

```jsx
<KenosUI.Prose>…</KenosUI.Prose>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="KenosUI.Prose">…</x-import>
```

## Notes

Layout for rendered Markdown. Elements look exactly like the matching components (h2 = Heading 3xl, table = Table sm/line, ``` = CodeBlock …).

## Props (ProseProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `html` | `string` | Already-rendered, SANITIZED HTML (e.g. from marked + DOMPurify). Use children instead with react-markdown. |
| `as` | `string` | Wrapper element, e.g. "article". Default "div". |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` |  |

_Also accepts: React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>._
